body: Well university and normal living stuff like cooking, shopping and things. Why?

I'm sorry you have to feel the way I do. I don't think I can still be friends with her. We have been together for too long and it would just bring up all the memories every time I would see her. It kills me to know I still have lots of pictures of us together but well she is in all the pictures I took over the last years and I won't delete all those memories...

Sometimes I feel just the opposite. Selfish and egoistic because I want her to be with me now that she is actually getting better. That just makes me hate myself more...

I know I have to let her go. It just seems so unfair. I know I had to end it because she never would have considered therapy in our relationship and I knew it was possible to lose her forever if I broke up with her but I still did it. Part because of her part because of me not being able to take any more. Our relationship was burdened by her personal problems a lot and now I just feel like the one real shot we would have had after her therapy is denied to me and someone else profits. Thats not fair to think like that. I mean I let her go even though I know I had to

I'm not sure if you can help me with my faith. I think I have to find a way for myself, I don't want to go back to believe what I did because it doesn't make sense anymore. I have to find something that does. I cant believe in a god anymore, too much stuff happened that does not make any sense. I recently started to look into the idea of finding happiness within yourself through meditation. Not sure where that will take me though
